soft_notes.observation: LLD line 73 explicitly prescribes this: 'Built once at import.' So this matches the design intent. Practical consequence: any module that imports `session.py` MUST have DATABASE_URL available in env (or .env) at import time. T-009 conftest must therefore export DATABASE_URL pointing at the testcontainers PG instance BEFORE importing src.infrastructure.db.session — standard pytest fixture order handles this, but worth pinning explicitly when T-009 is implemented.
